note: NEGATIVE-RESULT specimen, framing B (mechanism = the sampling control that explains the gains, null = the solo baseline). BEATS-NULL: SC-9 84.8 > solo 80.4 -> PASS (sampling genuinely captures the gain over the baseline). thesis_endpoint now literally in measured_endpoints -> THESIS-OUTRUNS-EVIDENCE should clear. NULL-RESULT-HONESTY: power 0.95 >= 0.80 -> PASS (well-powered rejection). The 'debate adds nothing' (84.4 vs 84.8) is a secondary equality, not the primary beats-null. This is the correct framing for a recast-negative claim.
